ALTER PROCEDURE BNKM.SP_PAYMENTCARDSTATEMENTSUMMARY_CCD
AS
BEGIN
--GET DELTA FROM BUSC

WITH TEMP_BNKM_PaymentCardStatementSummary
AS(SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CustomerAccountId ORDER BY INSERT_DTTM DESC ) RN, * FROM (
    SELECT
     BCC.CRDACCT_NBR AS CustomerAccountId
    ,convert(date,convert(varchar,BCC.CRDACCT_DATE_MAINT)) AS PeriodStartDate
    ,NULL AS PeriodEndDate
    ,BCC.CRDACCT_STMT_MIN_AMT_DUE AS MinimumPaymentAmount
    ,BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_PYMT_DUE AS PaymentDueDateNumberOfDays
    ,BCC.CRDACCT_STMT_CYC AS BillingCycleId
    ,BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_LST_STMT AS LastStatementDate
    ,BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_PRV_STMT AS LastPreviousStatementDate
    ,BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_PYMT_DUE AS PaymentDueDate
    ,BCC.CRDACCT_CRLIMIT AS CreditLimitAmount
    ,BCC.CRDACCT_TOT_AMT_DUE AS TotalAmountDue
    ,BCC.CRDACCT_CURR_DUE AS CurrentDueAmount
    ,BCC.CRDACCT_PAST_DUE AS PastDueAmount
    ,BCC.CRDACCT_STMT_BAL_RTL AS RetailStatementBalanceAmount
    ,BCC.CRDACCT_STMT_INT_RTL AS RetailStatementInterestAmount
    ,BCC.CRDACCT_STMT_BAL_CASH AS CashStatementBalanceAmount
    ,BCC.CRDACCT_STMT_INT_CASH AS CashStatementInterestAmount
    ,BCC.CRDACCT_OUTSTD_BAL AS  TotalOutstandingBalanceAmount
    ,BCC.CRDACCT_LST_PYMT_AMT AS LastPaymentAmount
    ,BCC.CRDACCT_PRIOR_YR_BP AS PriorYearBonusPoints
    ,BCC.CRDACCT_YTD_BP_STMT AS YearToDateStatementBonusPoints
    ,BCC.CRDACCT_CTD_BP_ADD AS CycleToDateBonusPointsAdded
    ,BCC.CRDACCT_CTD_BP_DED AS CycleToDateBonusPointsDeducted
    ,BCC.CRDACCT_MTD_BP_ADD AS MonthToDateBonusPointsAdded
    ,BCC.CRDACCT_MTD_BP_DED AS MonthToDateBonusPointsDeducted
    ,BCC.CRDACCT_MTD_BP_MDB AS MonthToDateBonusPointsMDB
    ,BCC.CRDACCT_OUTSTD_INSTL AS OutstandingInstallmentAmount
    ,BCC.CRDACCT_YTD_SPEND AS YearToDateSpend
    ,BCC.CRDACCT_PRV_YTD_SPEND AS PreviousYearToDateSpend
    ,BCC.CRDACCT_STMT_MIN_AMT_DUE AS StatementMinimumAmountDue
    ,BCCD.RECORD_STATUS
    ,BCC.INSERT_DTTM
    ,BCC.BNK_CODE
    FROM BUSC.CCD_CBCEXCACFP_DELTA BCCD
    LEFT JOIN BUSC.CCD_CBCEXCACFP BCC ON BCC.CRDACCT_NBR = BCCD.CRDACCT_NBR AND BCC.isLatest = '1'
where BCC.CRDACCT_NBR IS NOT NULL

UNION
    SELECT
     BCC.CRDACCT_NBR AS CustomerAccountId
    ,convert(date,convert(varchar,BCC.CRDACCT_DATE_MAINT)) AS PeriodStartDate
    ,NULL AS PeriodEndDate
    ,BCC.CRDACCT_STMT_MIN_AMT_DUE AS MinimumPaymentAmount
    ,BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_PYMT_DUE AS PaymentDueDateNumberOfDays
    ,BCC.CRDACCT_STMT_CYC AS BillingCycleId
    ,BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_LST_STMT AS LastStatementDate
    ,BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_PRV_STMT AS LastPreviousStatementDate
    ,BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_PYMT_DUE AS PaymentDueDate
    ,BCC.CRDACCT_CRLIMIT AS CreditLimitAmount
    ,BCC.CRDACCT_TOT_AMT_DUE AS TotalAmountDue
    ,BCC.CRDACCT_CURR_DUE AS CurrentDueAmount
    ,BCC.CRDACCT_PAST_DUE AS PastDueAmount
    ,BCC.CRDACCT_STMT_BAL_RTL AS RetailStatementBalanceAmount
    ,BCC.CRDACCT_STMT_INT_RTL AS RetailStatementInterestAmount
    ,BCC.CRDACCT_STMT_BAL_CASH AS CashStatementBalanceAmount
    ,BCC.CRDACCT_STMT_INT_CASH AS CashStatementInterestAmount    
    ,BCC.CRDACCT_OUTSTD_BAL AS  TotalOutstandingBalanceAmount
    ,BCC.CRDACCT_LST_PYMT_AMT AS LastPaymentAmount
    ,BCC.CRDACCT_PRIOR_YR_BP AS PriorYearBonusPoints
    ,BCC.CRDACCT_YTD_BP_STMT AS YearToDateStatementBonusPoints
    ,BCC.CRDACCT_CTD_BP_ADD AS CycleToDateBonusPointsAdded
    ,BCC.CRDACCT_CTD_BP_DED AS CycleToDateBonusPointsDeducted
    ,BCC.CRDACCT_MTD_BP_ADD AS MonthToDateBonusPointsAdded
    ,BCC.CRDACCT_MTD_BP_DED AS MonthToDateBonusPointsDeducted
    ,BCC.CRDACCT_MTD_BP_MDB AS MonthToDateBonusPointsMDB
    ,BCC.CRDACCT_OUTSTD_INSTL AS OutstandingInstallmentAmount
    ,BCC.CRDACCT_YTD_SPEND AS YearToDateSpend
    ,BCC.CRDACCT_PRV_YTD_SPEND AS PreviousYearToDateSpend
    ,BCC.CRDACCT_STMT_MIN_AMT_DUE AS StatementMinimumAmountDue
    ,BCCD.RECORD_STATUS
    ,BCC.INSERT_DTTM
    ,BCC.BNK_CODE
    FROM BUSC.CCD_CBCEXCACCP_DELTA BCCD
    LEFT JOIN BUSC.CCD_CBCEXCACCP BCC ON BCC.CRDACCT_NBR = BCCD.CRDACCT_NBR AND BCC.isLatest = '1'
  where BCC.CRDACCT_NBR IS NOT NULL 
)A)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_PaymentCardStatementSummary FROM TEMP_BNKM_PaymentCardStatementSummary WHERE RN =1;
--CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA
WITH
TEMP_BNKM_PaymentCardStatementSummary_SRC
AS(
    SELECT
    HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
     CustomerAccountId
    ,MinimumPaymentAmount
    ,PaymentDueDateNumberOfDays
    ,BillingCycleId
    ,LastStatementDate
    ,LastPreviousStatementDate
    ,PaymentDueDate
    ,CreditLimitAmount
    ,TotalAmountDue
    ,CurrentDueAmount
    ,PastDueAmount
    ,RetailStatementBalanceAmount
    ,RetailStatementInterestAmount
    ,CashStatementBalanceAmount
    ,CashStatementInterestAmount
    ,TotalOutstandingBalanceAmount
    ,LastPaymentAmount
    ,PriorYearBonusPoints
    ,YearToDateStatementBonusPoints
    ,CycleToDateBonusPointsAdded
    ,CycleToDateBonusPointsDeducted
    ,MonthToDateBonusPointsAdded
    ,MonthToDateBonusPointsDeducted
    ,MonthToDateBonusPointsMDB
    ,OutstandingInstallmentAmount
    ,YearToDateSpend
    ,PreviousYearToDateSpend
    ,StatementMinimumAmountDue
    )) HASHROW, CustomerAccountId, RECORD_STATUS, Periodstartdate
    FROM #TEMP_BNKM_PaymentCardStatementSummary WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
),

TEMP_BNKM_PaymentCardStatementSummary_TGT
AS(
    SELECT
    HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
     CustomerAccountId
    ,MinimumPaymentAmount
    ,PaymentDueDateNumberOfDays
    ,BillingCycleId
    ,LastStatementDate
    ,LastPreviousStatementDate
    ,PaymentDueDate
    ,CreditLimitAmount
    ,TotalAmountDue
    ,CurrentDueAmount
    ,PastDueAmount
    ,RetailStatementBalanceAmount
    ,RetailStatementInterestAmount
    ,CashStatementBalanceAmount
    ,CashStatementInterestAmount
    ,TotalOutstandingBalanceAmount
    ,LastPaymentAmount
    ,PriorYearBonusPoints
    ,YearToDateStatementBonusPoints
    ,CycleToDateBonusPointsAdded
    ,CycleToDateBonusPointsDeducted
    ,MonthToDateBonusPointsAdded
    ,MonthToDateBonusPointsDeducted
    ,MonthToDateBonusPointsMDB
    ,OutstandingInstallmentAmount
    ,YearToDateSpend
    ,PreviousYearToDateSpend
    ,StatementMinimumAmountDue
    )) HASHROW, CustomerAccountId,Periodstartdate
    FROM BNKM.PaymentCardStatementSummary WHERE PeriodEndDate IS NULL
),

TEMP_BNKM_PaymentCardStatementSummary_DELTA
AS(
    SELECT
    SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
    ,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
    ,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerAccountId, TGT.CustomerAccountId) AS CustomerAccountId
    ,ISNULL(SRC.Periodstartdate, TGT.Periodstartdate) AS Periodstartdate
    ,CASE
        WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
        ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS

    FROM TEMP_BNKM_PaymentCardStatementSummary_SRC SRC
    FULL OUTER JOIN TEMP_BNKM_PaymentCardStatementSummary_TGT TGT
    ON SRC.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId
    and SRC.Periodstartdate = TGT.Periodstartdate
    WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_PaymentCardStatementSummary_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_PaymentCardStatementSummary_DELTA
--UPDATE RECORDS TO BNKM
UPDATE TGT
SET
PeriodEndDate = SRC.PeriodStartDate
FROM BNKM.PaymentCardStatementSummary TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_PaymentCardStatementSummary_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId and DELTA.Periodstartdate = TGT.Periodstartdate AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_PaymentCardStatementSummary SRC ON SRC.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId
WHERE (TGT.PeriodEndDate IS NULL 
OR TGT.PeriodEndDate = '1900-01-01' )
AND TGT.SourceSystemCode = 'CCD'

--INSERT RECORDS WITH UPDATE

INSERT INTO BNKM.PaymentCardStatementSummary(
 CustomerAccountId
,PeriodStartDate
,PeriodEndDate
,MinimumPaymentAmount
,InterestRatePeriodInDays
,PaymentDueDateNumberOfDays
,BillingCycleId
,LastStatementDate
,LastPreviousStatementDate
,PaymentDueDate
,CreditLimitAmount
,TotalAmountDue
,CurrentDueAmount
,PastDueAmount
,RetailStatementBalanceAmount
,RetailStatementInterestAmount
,CashStatementBalanceAmount
,CashStatementInterestAmount
,TotalOutstandingBalanceAmount
,LastPaymentAmount
,PriorYearBonusPoints
,YearToDateStatementBonusPoints
,CycleToDateBonusPointsAdded
,CycleToDateBonusPointsDeducted
,MonthToDateBonusPointsAdded
,MonthToDateBonusPointsDeducted
,MonthToDateBonusPointsMDB
,OutstandingInstallmentAmount
,YearToDateSpend
,PreviousYearToDateSpend
,StatementMinimumAmountDue
,FINANCIALINSTITUTIONId
,sourcesystemcode
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm
)

SELECT
 SRC.CustomerAccountId AS CustomerAccountId
,convert(date,convert(varchar,SRC.PeriodStartDate))AS PeriodStartDate
,convert(date,convert(varchar,SRC.PeriodEndDate))AS PeriodEndDate
,SRC.MinimumPaymentAmount AS MinimumPaymentAmount
,NULL AS InterestRatePeriodInDays
,SRC.PaymentDueDateNumberOfDays AS PaymentDueDateNumberOfDays
,SRC.BillingCycleId AS BillingCycleId
,SRC.LastStatementDate AS LastStatementDate
,SRC.LastPreviousStatementDate AS LastPreviousStatementDate
,SRC.PaymentDueDate AS PaymentDueDate
,SRC.CreditLimitAmount AS CreditLimitAmount
,SRC.TotalAmountDue AS TotalAmountDue
,SRC.CurrentDueAmount AS CurrentDueAmount
,SRC.PastDueAmount AS PastDueAmount
,SRC.RetailStatementBalanceAmount AS RetailStatementBalanceAmount
,SRC.RetailStatementInterestAmount AS RetailStatementInterestAmount
,SRC.CashStatementBalanceAmount AS CashStatementBalanceAmount
,SRC.CashStatementInterestAmount AS CashStatementInterestAmount
,SRC.TotalOutstandingBalanceAmount AS TotalOutstandingBalanceAmount
,SRC.LastPaymentAmount AS LastPaymentAmount
,SRC.PriorYearBonusPoints AS PriorYearBonusPoints
,SRC.YearToDateStatementBonusPoints AS YearToDateStatementBonusPoints
,SRC.CycleToDateBonusPointsAdded AS CycleToDateBonusPointsAdded
,SRC.CycleToDateBonusPointsDeducted AS CycleToDateBonusPointsDeducted
,SRC.MonthToDateBonusPointsAdded AS MonthToDateBonusPointsAdded
,SRC.MonthToDateBonusPointsDeducted AS MonthToDateBonusPointsDeducted
,SRC.MonthToDateBonusPointsMDB AS MonthToDateBonusPointsMDB
,SRC.OutstandingInstallmentAmount AS OutstandingInstallmentAmount
,SRC.YearToDateSpend AS YearToDateSpend
,SRC.PreviousYearToDateSpend AS PreviousYearToDateSpend
,SRC.StatementMinimumAmountDue AS StatementMinimumAmountDue
,SRC.BNK_CODE AS FINANCIALINSTITUTIONId
,'CCD' AS sourcesystemcode
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_PaymentCardStatementSummary SRC
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_PaymentCardStatementSummary_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE' AND DELTA.CustomerAccountId = SRC.CustomerAccountId AND DELTA.periodstartdate = SRC.periodstartdate


--INSERT RECORDS TO BNKM

INSERT INTO BNKM.PaymentCardStatementSummary(
 CustomerAccountId
,PeriodStartDate
,PeriodEndDate
,MinimumPaymentAmount
,InterestRatePeriodInDays
,PaymentDueDateNumberOfDays
,BillingCycleId
,LastStatementDate
,LastPreviousStatementDate
,PaymentDueDate
,CreditLimitAmount
,TotalAmountDue
,CurrentDueAmount
,PastDueAmount
,RetailStatementBalanceAmount
,RetailStatementInterestAmount
,CashStatementBalanceAmount
,CashStatementInterestAmount
,TotalOutstandingBalanceAmount
,LastPaymentAmount
,PriorYearBonusPoints
,YearToDateStatementBonusPoints
,CycleToDateBonusPointsAdded
,CycleToDateBonusPointsDeducted
,MonthToDateBonusPointsAdded
,MonthToDateBonusPointsDeducted
,MonthToDateBonusPointsMDB
,OutstandingInstallmentAmount
,YearToDateSpend
,PreviousYearToDateSpend
,StatementMinimumAmountDue
,FINANCIALINSTITUTIONId
,SOURCESYSTEMCODE
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm
)

SELECT
 CustomerAccountId AS CustomerAccountId
,convert(date,convert(varchar,PeriodStartDate)) AS PeriodStartDate
,convert(date,convert(varchar,PeriodEndDate)) AS PeriodEndDate
,MinimumPaymentAmount AS MinimumPaymentAmount
,NULL AS InterestRatePeriodInDays
,PaymentDueDateNumberOfDays AS PaymentDueDateNumberOfDays
,BillingCycleId AS BillingCycleId
,LastStatementDate AS LastStatementDate
,LastPreviousStatementDate AS LastPreviousStatementDate
,PaymentDueDate AS PaymentDueDate
,CreditLimitAmount AS CreditLimitAmount
,TotalAmountDue AS TotalAmountDue
,CurrentDueAmount AS CurrentDueAmount
,PastDueAmount AS PastDueAmount
,RetailStatementBalanceAmount AS RetailStatementBalanceAmount
,RetailStatementInterestAmount AS RetailStatementInterestAmount
,CashStatementBalanceAmount AS CashStatementBalanceAmount
,CashStatementInterestAmount AS CashStatementInterestAmount
,TotalOutstandingBalanceAmount AS TotalOutstandingBalanceAmount
,LastPaymentAmount AS LastPaymentAmount
,PriorYearBonusPoints AS PriorYearBonusPoints
,YearToDateStatementBonusPoints AS YearToDateStatementBonusPoints
,CycleToDateBonusPointsAdded AS CycleToDateBonusPointsAdded
,CycleToDateBonusPointsDeducted AS CycleToDateBonusPointsDeducted
,MonthToDateBonusPointsAdded AS MonthToDateBonusPointsAdded
,MonthToDateBonusPointsDeducted AS MonthToDateBonusPointsDeducted
,MonthToDateBonusPointsMDB AS MonthToDateBonusPointsMDB
,OutstandingInstallmentAmount AS OutstandingInstallmentAmount
,YearToDateSpend AS YearToDateSpend
,PreviousYearToDateSpend AS PreviousYearToDateSpend
,StatementMinimumAmountDue AS StatementMinimumAmountDue
,BNK_CODE AS FINANCIALINSTITUTIONId
,'CCD' AS SOURCESYSTEMCODE
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,INSERT_DTTM AS INSERTDTTM
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_PaymentCardStatementSummary
WHERE RECORD_STATUS IN ('INSERT');

DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_PaymentCardStatementSummary;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_PaymentCardStatementSummary_DELTA;

END
